The '''Destruction of the Deretta Destroyers''' was a battle during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces in which the [[Deretta Destroyers]], a Rebel [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]], was destroyed.<ref name="GG3" />
